summary: Agnico Eagle Mines filed a Form 6-K furnishing its third-quarter 2026 earnings press release dated October 28, 2026. Payable gold production was 814,012 ounces at production costs of $1,193/oz, total cash costs of $1,133/oz and AISC of $1,648/oz, with realized gold prices of $4,264/oz. Net income was $1,353 million ($2.67/share), adjusted net income $1,324 million ($2.62/share), operating cash flow $1,755 million and free cash flow $852 million. Management reaffirmed full-year guidance and progress at Hope Bay, Odyssey, Upper Beaver and Detour Lake. This is a routine quarterly results filing, not a special situation.
